text:
tom_pinewave: Hey team, procurement at PineWave wants a quick compliance bundle for the POC next Thurs: SOC 2 Type II scope summary, an ISO27001 control mapping for data residency + crypto controls, and either a signed pen-test attestation or a redacted vuln summary. They also asked whether we can enable ephemeral staging creds for their engineers. Who can help?
alejandra_sales: Hi Tom 44b We can assemble SOC2 + ISO extracts. For pen-test we usually provide a signed attestation letter and a redacted finding summary (no raw reports). Ephemeral creds are possible via our short-lived API keys flow. Nate, confirm TTL and restrictions?
nate_se: We can issue ephemeral keys with 1h TTL and scope-limited to inference endpoints and the staging bucket. We need the CI/CD IP allowlist or CIDRs for peering. I can script key rotation if they want automated creds.
tom_pinewave: 1h TTL sounds good. They also need assurance on data residency: can you confirm logs and backups for the POC will stay in eu-west-1?
emma_security: For POC on our Hosted EU cluster we keep logs/backups in eu-west-1. We can include a redacted retention policy excerpt and the encryption-at-rest statement. Note: full retention buckets are internal-only, we'll provide an excerpt.
joel_compliance: SOC 2: I'll extract the scope page and control matrix mapping that shows which subservice orgs and services are covered. I'll redact internal operational runbooks. Expect upload to s3 by EOD: s3://redwood-compliance/pinewave/poc-bundle/soc2-scope.pdf
ate_se: small note on pen-test: we cannot share raw vuln screenshots or PoCs. Our attestation covers that a third-party pentest was performed and critical/major findings were remediated. We can attach a one-page redacted findings summary.
alejandra_sales: Legal check: has PineWave signed the data processing addendum and the NDA? Tom?
tom_pinewave: DPA signed yesterday. NDA executed last month.
deploy_bot: automated: Please include customer name and tenant-id for attestation. Attach tenant-id in reply to this thread.
tom_pinewave: tenant-id: pinewave-prod-9. Also contact: security@pinewave.io.
joel_compliance: Uploading ISO control map and SOC2 scope now. Also creating a 2-page redacted A.10 (cryptography) excerpt per their ask.
emma_security: Draft pen-test attestation ready at /legal/drafts/pinewave-pen-attest.docx. I will request signature from legal. ETA 6 business hours for legal review.
nate_se: I created a short runbook for ephemeral creds and IP allowlist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ephemeral-keys. For the POC we'll need the customer's CIDRs and the list of users who need the creds.
alejandra_sales: Pricing for Dedicated isolation during POC (1x A100 equiv) with EU residency + VPC peering: estimate ~ $3,500 for the week. If they want dedicated GPUs + private endpoint that becomes a reserved short-term commit, I'll confirm exact terms with finance.
tom_pinewave: They prefer Hosted EU with isolated tenancy + ephemeral creds. Can you include a one-line SOW and setup ETA?
emma_security: Setup ETA for hosted-eu isolated tenancy + network peering: 36-48 hours after receiving CIDRs and peering approvals.
joel_compliance: Bundle checklist: SOC2 excerpt, ISO A.10 excerpt, pen-test attestation (signed), redacted findings summary, ephemeral-keys runbook link, SOW one-liner. I'll upload the PDFs to s3 and share link here when done.
alejandra_sales: I'll assemble email to security@pinewave.io and copy Emma. Will include pricing ballpark and SOW.
tom_pinewave: Thanks everyone. Please post s3 links and let me know if legal blocks the attestation signing.
emma_security: Legal notified. Automated review ok; manual signatory assigned to @alejandra_sales.
deploy_bot: automated: Files uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/pinewave/poc-bundle/ (restricted). Access granted to pinewave-prod-9 if NDA present.
joel_compliance: SOC2 + ISO excerpts uploaded. Pen-test attestation marked "pending signature" in /legal/drafts. Redacted findings summary uploaded. Links: s3://redwood-compliance/pinewave/poc-bundle/soc2-scope.pdf, s3://redwood-compliance/pinewave/poc-bundle/iso-a10-excerpt.pdf, s3://redwood-compliance/pinewave/poc-bundle/penredacted-summary.pdf
alejandra_sales: Sending bundle now. I'll update thread after legal signs the attestation. :white_check_mark:
tom_pinewave: Great, thanks all. Appreciated the fast turnaround.
joel_compliance: Ping me if auditors ask for control mappings to specific tests; I can produce a mapping table.
alejandra_sales: Closing thread after confirmation sent to customer. :lock:
